story: I’m Zara — I help you spot energy, water, and sustainability deals that matter for busy sites. Start on the **Deals wire** for live lane counts and new spotlights, then open the desk for the ticker hub, energy portal, and water finder. I keep the chat short and put full tools on the right so you can browse while we talk. Service-hour cost board shows illustrative peak vs off-peak kitchen €/mo when timing matters as much as the tariff. When you need deep payback maths or product search, I hand you to Vincent or Zyanne.
